 spell_effect_365 = {	# add_character_modifier_magic_boneshaping_modifier
	if = {
	   limit = {
		   exists = scope:cantrip_scope
	   }
	   scope:cantrip_scope = {
		   if = { limit = { exists = var:magic_boneshaping_modifier_scale } change_variable = { name = magic_boneshaping_modifier_scale add = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value } }
		   else = { set_variable = { name = magic_boneshaping_modifier_scale value = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value } }
	   }
	   refresh_stacking_modifier_effect = { MODIFIER = magic_boneshaping_modifier TYPE = character }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { exists = scope:cantrip_removal_mode } refresh_stacking_modifier_effect = { MODIFIER = magic_boneshaping_modifier TYPE = character } }
	else = {
	   upgrade_stacking_modifier_by_level_effect = { MODIFIER = magic_boneshaping_modifier TYPE = character LEVEL = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value MONTHS = -1  }
	}

	   scope:cantrip_scope = {
		   if = { limit = { exists = var:magic_arcane_degeneration_modifier_scale } change_variable = { name = magic_arcane_degeneration_modifier_scale add = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value } }
		   else = { set_variable = { name = magic_arcane_degeneration_modifier_scale value = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value } }
	   }
	   refresh_stacking_modifier_effect = { MODIFIER = magic_arcane_degeneration_modifier TYPE = character }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { exists = scope:cantrip_removal_mode } refresh_stacking_modifier_effect = { MODIFIER = magic_arcane_degeneration_modifier TYPE = character } }
	else = {
	   upgrade_stacking_modifier_by_level_effect = { MODIFIER = magic_arcane_degeneration_modifier TYPE = character LEVEL = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value MONTHS = -1  }

 spell_effect_535 = {	# add_character_modifier_magic_health_gain_modifier_permanent
	if = {
	   limit = {
		   exists = scope:cantrip_scope
	   }
	   scope:cantrip_scope = {
		   if = { limit = { exists = var:magic_health_gain_modifier_permanent_scale } change_variable = { name = magic_health_gain_modifier_permanent_scale add = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value } }
		   else = { set_variable = { name = magic_health_gain_modifier_permanent_scale value = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value } }
	   }
	   refresh_stacking_modifier_effect = { MODIFIER = magic_health_gain_modifier_permanent TYPE = character }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { exists = scope:cantrip_removal_mode } refresh_stacking_modifier_effect = { MODIFIER = magic_health_gain_modifier_permanent TYPE = character } }
	else = {
	   upgrade_stacking_modifier_by_level_effect = { MODIFIER = magic_health_gain_modifier_permanent TYPE = character LEVEL = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value MONTHS = -1  }
	}
 }

 spell_effect_971 = {	# add_character_modifier_manoakolaxia_modifier_permanent
	if = {
	   limit = {
		   exists = scope:cantrip_scope
	   }
	   scope:cantrip_scope = {
		   if = { limit = { exists = var:manoakolaxia_modifier_permanent_scale } change_variable = { name = manoakolaxia_modifier_permanent_scale add = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value } }

 spell_effect_1290 = {	# learn_random_magic_school_spell
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:effect_display_mode }
		custom_tooltip = learns_random_school_ritual_tooltip
	}
	else = {
		scope:spell_effect.var:magic_school = {
			random_in_list = {
				variable = spell_list
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						scope:spell_target = {
							trigger_if = {
								limit = { has_variable_list = known_spell_list }
								is_target_in_variable_list = {
									name = known_spell_list
									target = prev
								}
							}
						}
					}
					scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value >= spell_level_value
				}
				save_scope_as = learn_arcane_knowledge_spell_scope
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:learn_arcane_knowledge_spell_scope }
			learn_spell_effect = { SPELL = scope:learn_arcane_knowledge_spell_scope }
		}
		else = {
			scope:spell_effect.var:magic_school = { generate_procedural_spell_effect = { LEVEL = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value QUALITY = 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:new_spell_scope }
				learn_spell_effect = { SPELL = scope:new_spell_scope }
			}
		}
	}

 }

 spell_effect_1295 = {	# add_hook_strong
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:spell_effect.var:second_target_type ?= flag:spell_organizer
			NOT = { scope:spell_organizer ?= this }
		}
		add_hook = {
			type = domination_hook_strong
			target = scope:spell_organizer
			years = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:spell_effect.var:second_target_type ?= flag:target
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_list
			limit = { NOT = { this = prev } }
			prev = {
				add_hook = {
					type = domination_hook_strong
					target = prev
					years = 3
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:spell_organizer ?= this } }
		scope:spell_organizer = {
			add_hook = {
				type = domination_hook_strong
				target = prev
				years = 3
			}
		}
	}

 spell_effect_1300 = {	# add_ritual_to_enchantment_list
	add_to_variable_list = {
		name = enchantment_list
		target = scope:spell_being_casted
	}
	save_scope_as = enchanted_artifact_scope
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:spell_effect.var:enchantment_style }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:spell_effect.var:enchantment_style = flag:inscription }
			set_artifact_description = GH_artifact_enchantment_inscription
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:spell_effect.var:enchantment_style = flag:gemstone }
			set_artifact_description = GH_artifact_enchantment_gemstone
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_artifact_description = GH_artifact_enchantment_generic
	}
	# Upgrade rarity based on enchantment power
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = var:total_enchantment_power } }
		set_variable = {
			name = total_enchantment_power
			value = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value
		}
	}
	else = {
		limit = { exists = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value }
		change_variable = {
			name = total_enchantment_power
			add = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			artifact_rarity <= 2
			exists = var:total_enchantment_power
			var:total_enchantment_power >= 1
		}
		set_artifact_rarity = masterwork
		change_variable = {
			name = total_enchantment_power
			subtract = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			artifact_rarity = 3
			exists = var:total_enchantment_power
			var:total_enchantment_power >= 2
		}
		set_artifact_rarity = famed
		change_variable = {
			name = total_enchantment_power
			subtract = 2
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			artifact_rarity = 4
			exists = var:total_enchantment_power
			var:total_enchantment_power >= 3
		}
		set_artifact_rarity = illustrious
		change_variable = {
			name = total_enchantment_power
			subtract = 3
		}
	}

 }
 spell_effect_1301 = {	# destroy_sun
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = destroy_sun_tooltip
		scope:spell_organizer ?= { create_story = story_cycle_sundeath }
	}

	scope:spell_organizer = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = spell_component_being_prepared_list
				any_in_list = {
					variable = spell_component_being_prepared_list
					exists = var:spell_component_template.var:artifact_type
					var:spell_component_template.var:artifact_type = flag:prism
				}
			}
			random_in_list = {
				variable = spell_component_being_prepared_list
				limit = {
					exists = var:spell_component_template.var:artifact_type
					var:spell_component_template.var:artifact_type = flag:prism
				}
				var:spell_component_artifact_selection = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = charge_mana_prism_infinite_tooltip
						
						set_variable = {
							name = stored_mana
							value = -1
						}
					}
					add_artifact_aspect_modifier_effect = { NAME = light VALUE = 100 }
					add_artifact_aspect_modifier_effect = { NAME = fire VALUE = 50 }
					add_artifact_aspect_modifier_effect = { NAME = celestial VALUE = 50 }
					
					set_artifact_name = artifact_sun_prism_name
					set_artifact_description = artifact_sun_prism_desc
				}
			}
		}
		gh_achiev_nothingcouldgowrong_check = yes
	}

 }

 spell_effect_1310 = {	# create_artifact_necklace
	save_scope_as = owner
	save_scope_as = goldsmith
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = wealth
		value = {
			value = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value
			multiply = 10
		}
	}
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = quality
		value = {
			value = scope:spell_effect.spell_tag_scalar_threshold_diff_value
			multiply = 10
		}
	}
	hidden_effect_new_object = {
		create_artifact = {
			name = GH_artifact_necklace_magic_crafted_name
			creator = scope:goldsmith
			description = placeholder #properly set later
			visuals = necklace
			type = necklace
			modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier
			wealth = scope:wealth
			quality = scope:quality
			save_scope_as = newly_created_artifact
		}
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			#Loc
			get_artifact_feature_references_effect = yes
			set_artifact_description = artifact_necklace_description
			remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						rarity = famed
						rarity = illustrious
					}
				}
				add_scaled_artifact_modifier_minor_prestige_effect = yes	# Highly impressive magical objects should be inherently prestigious and majestic
				add_scaled_artifact_modifier_majesty_effect = yes
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = quality
				value = scope:quality
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = wealth
				value = scope:wealth
			}
			add_to_list = newly_created_artifact_list   # Since target list compilation is normally done before any effects are applied
			add_to_list = target_artifact_list  # GH TODO: PROVISIONAL, FIGURE OUT WHY THE EFFECT BELOW IS BROKEN
		}
	}

 }

			type = gemstone
			modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier

			quality = scope:quality
			save_scope_as = newly_created_artifact
		}
		scope:newly_created_artifact = {
			#Loc
			get_artifact_feature_references_effect = yes
			set_artifact_feature_group = gemstone_magical_texture

					}

				add_scaled_artifact_modifier_majesty_effect = yes

			visuals = gh_mount_golem

			modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier

			quality = scope:quality

		}

			#Loc

					OR = {

			set_variable = {
				name = quality
				value = scope:quality
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = wealth
				value = scope:wealth
			}
			add_to_list = newly_created_artifact_list   # Since target list compilation is normally done before any effects are applied

 spell_effect_1320 = {	# dream_glimpse_reality
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag =  casted_glimpse_reality } }
		custom_tooltip = glimpse_reality.tooltip
		if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:spell_organizer }
				scope:spell_organizer = { trigger_event = glimpse_reality.0001 }
		}
		else = { trigger_event = glimpse_reality.0001 }
		if = {
				limit = {
					scope:spell_organizer = {
						dream_aspect_skill_trigger = { VALUE = 10 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spell_organizer = {
								dream_aspect_skill_trigger = { VALUE = 20 }
						}
					}
					add_character_flag = {
						flag = casted_glimpse_reality
						years = 1
					}
				}
				else = {
					add_character_flag = {
						flag = casted_glimpse_reality
						years = 2
					}
				}
		}
		else = {
				add_character_flag = {
					flag = casted_glimpse_reality
					years = 3
				}
		}
	}
	else = {
		custom_tooltip = {
				text = glimpse_reality_limited_tt
				add_stress = major_stress_impact_gain
		}
	}

 }
